job.job_description:
Experience in building and deploying GenAI/LLM-based solutions using Azure AI Foundry.
Hands-on work with Prompt Engineering, RAG architectures, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience in creating agents using LangGraph/Langchain
Experience in configuring and consuming Azure OpenAI models (GPT-4o, embeddings, etc.).
Experience on deploying AI solutions, exposing solutions as REST API in containerized solutions
Knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks, orchestration, and multi-agent solutions.
Hands on experience with Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Model Validation & Performance Evaluation, Statistical Modeling & Forecasting
Adept at using Prompt Engineering and Retrieval Augmented Generation
Experience with evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and responsible AI controls.
Integration with Azure services such as AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions, Logic Apps, and API Management.
Experience in fine-tuning/customization, model selection, and performance optimization.
Exposure to CI/CD, deployment, and productionization of AI solutions.
